primary_ecological_estimability_question: Can the effect of native versus exotic forest on endemic, nonendemic native and introduced arthropod richness be distinguished from forest-elevation covariation within balanced original 2024 Terceira plots? Do NOT open original species/taxon values unless the source conditions have overlapping sampling environmental support.

prior_published_nonbiological_source_inf.publication: Lhoumeau & Borges 2025 Forest Ecology and Management 596:123059 DOI 10.1016/j.foreco.2025.123059, sections 2.1-2.2. This is already published prior art, not an original Structural measurement.

only_allowed_original_values.core: Original Event 326 source rows, original source primary Event core ID, island, eventDate, locationID, habitat, samplingProtocol, minimumElevationInMeters, eventRemarks, locationRemarks, geocoordinates, sampleSizeValue/Unit
only_allowed_original_values.source_file_members_read: Event text and meta.xml ONLY; original 2399 Occurrence rows NEVER read at v1.333
only_allowed_original_values.publish: Only exact author plot count, source habitat class count, elev ranges, overlap and source method/height counts, no original site IDs or coordinates, no species or origin status

author_site_design.site_identity: Exact source original locationID normalized NFKD ASCII uppercase and retain A-Z0-9; no nearest coordinate reconstruction, no drop/change author plot tokens after original Event look.
author_site_design.site_habitat_read_only: Use original Event habitat source column. Strip whitespace, casefold and spaces; no inferred native/exotic from original locality or taxon.
author_site_design.original_source_event_incomplete_or_inva: STOP rather than impute plot elevation from nearest mountain DEM or source paper elevation range
author_site_design.method_gate: Original exact samplingProtocol must be classifiable as SLAM vs Pitfall from Event-only field. SLAM source events by height GRD (0%), UND (50%), CAN (75%) from author original eventRemarks/locationRemarks, no taxon-guided method parsing. EPI ground Pitfall separate, not comparable to SLAM.
author_site_design.fixed_comparable_sampling_channel: SLAM ground GRD only for mandatory source habitat comparison; if original source authors' GRD not present at ≥8 plots of each habitat, no physical-plot habitat endpoint. Other heights are descriptive source design only.
author_site_design.source_date: Require source 2024 sampling, early summer–early autumn; if dates are intervals, accept YYYY-MM-DD prefix but not an inferred season from species.

environmental_overlap_gate.primary_causal_estimability: STRICT. Need elevation range overlap of source native and exotic physical plot locations PLUS at least 2 independent native and 2 exotic original plot elevations inside the intersection AND ≥8 sites per type with source-matched SLAM ground stratum.
environmental_overlap_gate.common_elevation_interval_m: intersection(max(min native, min exotic), min(max native, max exotic)); empty intersection => FOREST_ELEVATION_STRUCTURAL_NONOVERLAP_TERMINAL
environmental_overlap_gate.assay_when_causal_gate_fails: No 2024 source species/origin read under forest habitat mechanism endpoint; mark forest type vs elevation not separately identifiable. No alternative extrapolating regression, propensity weighting with 0 overlap, or source-outcome-selected subsets.
environmental_overlap_gate.scientific_association_vs_causal: One can describe source forest richness by type without isolating elevation, but this task targets *mechanism*, so do not reopen taxa to imply an independent habitat effect when no support.

null_and_possible_next.if_pass: Freeze v1.334 origin/capture model on matched ground-SLAM site source effort and original elevation-common-support sites before first taxon record.
null_and_possible_next.if_fail: Close 2024 source forest mechanism with zero original Occurrence read. Use prior published 2025 native/exotic vertical β as context only. Recommend future elevation-matched forest pairs or transects where both native and altered stands occur within shared elevation range.
null_and_possible_next.published_prior_art: Lhoumeau & Borges 2025 vertical decay did not differ between forest types, nonindigenous arthropods had narrower vertical ranges; do not claim that as new Structural.
